RFC1332-2-1.note: Judge ppp4 2026-09-30. Re-read after the frame_test.go negative moved to RFC1661-5-2 (it proved Length validation, a neighbour). Still proven by TestIPCPOnePacketPerFrameThroughRun: ze's IPCP CONFREQ from run() is 0x8021 with Length == Information length (+); a 0x8021 frame carrying a CONFREQ and a trailing Terminate-Request draws the Configure-Ack alone and no Terminate-Ack in 1 s (-, receiver-side injection).

RFC1332-2.1-1.note: Judge 2026-09-29. Network-phase clause now driven: TestNCPHeldUntilNetworkPhase/ipv4, CHAP pending 3 s -> no frame, no address request, no AddAddressP2P (-); accepted -> address request and IPCP Configure-Request. Opened clause unchanged: TestIPCPNoAddressBeforeOpened / TestIPResponseConfiguresInterface. Observed red with runAuthPhase broken; an NCP started beside or before authentication writes a frame inside the 3 s window by construction.

RFC1332-2.1-3.note: Judge ppp5 2026-09-30. Unit gained the RFC1332-2.1-4 tags only; body unchanged. TestIPMTUInstalledFromNegotiatedMRU fails unless exactly one MTU is installed on ppp7 and it equals the peer's negotiated MRU 1400 (the largest IP packet sent = the Information-field maximum); 1400 differs from the 1500 default and MaxMRU, so a producer ignoring the negotiated MRU is red (forced-input negative, R1 b). Recorded afterLCPOpen revert.

RFC1332-2.1-4.note: Judge ppp5 2026-09-30. Row is the verbatim second sentence of RFC 1332 Section 2.1. The Linux IPv4 output path fragments on the pppN MTU; Ze's part is the MTU it installs, which this row's tests assert at the boundary Ze owns (rfc-compliance: a requirement met through a lower layer still carries a test over the value Ze installs). TestIPMTUInstalledFromNegotiatedMRU: exactly one MTU on ppp7, equal to the peer MRU 1400 (+); no MTU above 1400, 1500 included (-). Kernel fragmentation itself is not observed (would need a guest kernel); the claim states only the installed MTU. Records: afterLCPOpen revert, both polarities.

RFC1332-3-1.note: Send side now tagged: TestIPCPOptionsWrittenInLCPFormat compares WriteIPCPOptions output byte for byte (Types 3/129/131, Length 6, four octets) and walks it with ParseLCPOptions; any drift of Type, Length or Data is red. Receive side: TestIPCPParseOptions decodes a well-formed list, TestIPCPParseRejects refuses malformed TLVs with the exact errors.

RFC1332-3.3-2.note: Forbidden: a Configure-Nak IP-Address that is not acceptable as the remote address. TestIPCPNakCarriesTheAssignedRemoteAddress asserts the Nak carries the assigned 10.0.0.2 for a request of 10.9.9.9 and for a request with no address, red if another value is given. TestIPCPNakNeverCarriesAnUnacceptableAddress asserts the requested address is not echoed and that with nothing assigned the option is omitted rather than written invalid. The 'or indicate a request' branch is a permitted alternative Ze does not use.
